answer: Because the umber count is verified against the inlet text itself, the mesa audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 23 aliases hence means producing 23 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 4 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. That is 26 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
